column1: # C++: classes and structs with a body (class), enums (class), functions (function), members
# defined outside their class (method, named by the last segment and owned by the class
# written in front of it). A forward declaration (`class Cache;`) is not a definition.
# Export and attribute macros in front of a class or function are masked before the
# definition is read. Declarations without a body and `using` aliases are not
# listed; see KNOWN_GAPS.md. A googletest or benchmark test (TEST, TEST_F,
# TEST_P, TYPED_TEST, BENCHMARK_F) is one function named by its arguments, Suite.Name; any other
# upper-case macro in function position with no return type (REGISTER_THING(x) { }, MY_MACRO(a, b) { })
# is not a definition (tests.cc). A variable constructed by declaration is a reference, not a definition.
